# Key bindings

<!-- Generated by documentation.lua from keybindings.lua. Do not edit by hand:
     change keybindings.lua, then run `lua documentation.lua` in the plugin folder. -->

vi-xournalpp starts in **tool mode**. Press a mode key to enter another mode:
the next key runs one action there and takes you back to tool mode.
Enter a mode with **Shift** to make it **sticky**: it stays active until you press `t`.
A key that does nothing in a one-shot mode acts as it would in tool mode,
a one-shot mode ends by itself after 5 seconds without a key press,
and `t` returns to tool mode from every mode.
While typing in a text box, use **Alt** + a color key (listed under tool mode),
because plain letters are typed into the text.

| Mode | Enter | Sticky |
|---|---|---|
| [Tool](#tool-mode) | `t` |  |
| [Color](#color-mode) | `c` | `Shift+c` |
| [Shape](#shape-mode) | `s` | `Shift+s` |
| [Linestyle](#linestyle-mode) | `q` | `Shift+q` |
| [Page](#page-mode) | `b`, `p` | `Shift+b`, `Shift+p` |
| [File](#file-mode) | `f` | `Shift+f` |
| [More tool](#moretool-mode) | `m` | `Shift+m` |
| [Navigation](#navigation-mode) | `n` | `Shift+n` |
| [Visual](#visual-mode) | `v` | `Shift+v` |
| [Resize](#resize-mode) | `r` | `Shift+r` |

<a id="tool-mode"></a>

## Tool mode (`t`)

* Bigger text font: `Ctrl+]`
* Black: `Alt+x`
* Blue: `Alt+u`
* Brown: `Alt+d`
* Compass: `Shift+o`
* Default tool: `d`
* Eraser: `e`
* Gray: `Alt+a`
* Green: `Alt+Shift+g`
* Hand: `u`
* Highlighter: `g`
* Image: `i`
* Light blue: `Alt+b`
* Light green: `Alt+g`
* Magenta: `Alt+m`
* New page after: `a`
* Orange: `Alt+o`
* Pen: `w`
* Pink: `Alt+q`
* Purple: `Alt+s`
* Red: `Alt+r`
* Redo: `y`
* Setsquare: `Shift+e`
* Smaller text font: `Ctrl+[`
* Text: `x`
* Text font: `` Ctrl+` ``
* Undo: `z`
* White: `Alt+w`
* Yellow: `Alt+y`
* Zoom in: `>`, `+`
* Zoom out: `<`, `-`
* Zoom to fit: `o`

<a id="color-mode"></a>

## Color mode (`c`, sticky `Shift+c`)

* Black: `x`
* Blue: `Shift+b`, `u`
* Brown: `n`
* Gray: `a`, `Shift+x`
* Green: `e`, `Shift+g`
* Light blue: `b`
* Light green: `g`
* Magenta: `m`
* Orange: `c`, `o`
* Pink: `i`, `q`
* Purple: `p`, `s`
* Red: `r`
* White: `w`
* Yellow: `y`

<a id="shape-mode"></a>

## Shape mode (`s`, sticky `Shift+s`)

* Arrow: `a`
* Coordinate system: `c`
* Double arrow: `d`
* Ellipse: `e`
* Fill: `f`
* Rectangle: `r`
* Ruler: `s`, `u`
* Shape recogniser: `g`
* Spline: `p`, `q`

<a id="linestyle-mode"></a>

## Linestyle mode (`q`, sticky `Shift+q`)

* Dash-dotted: `f`
* Dashed: `s`
* Dotted: `d`
* Plain: `a`, `p`

<a id="page-mode"></a>

## Page mode (`b`, `p`, sticky `Shift+b`, `Shift+p`)

* Copy page: `c`
* Delete layer: `Shift+y`
* Delete page: `x`
* Dotted background: `o`
* Graph background: `g`
* Isometric dotted background: `Shift+o`
* Isometric graph background: `Shift+g`
* Move page down: `d`
* Move page up: `u`
* New layer: `y`
* New page after: `a`
* New page at end: `e`
* New page before: `Shift+a`
* Plain background: `p`
* Ruled background: `r`
* Ruled with vertical line background: `v`
* Staves background: `s`

<a id="file-mode"></a>

## File mode (`f`, sticky `Shift+f`)

* Annotate PDF: `a`
* Export as PDF: `e`
* New file: `n`
* Open file: `o`
* Print: `p`
* Quit: `q`
* Save file: `s`, `w`
* Save file as: `Shift+s`, `Shift+w`

<a id="moretool-mode"></a>

## More tool mode (`m`, sticky `Shift+m`)

* Compass: `c`
* LaTeX: `x`
* Setsquare: `e`, `s`

<a id="navigation-mode"></a>

## Navigation mode (`n`, sticky `Shift+n`)

* Go back to last visited page: `v`
* Go to bottom: `d`
* Go to first page: `f`
* Go to last page: `e`, `Shift+f`
* Go to top: `u`
* Layer down: `y`
* Layer up: `x`
* Next annotated page: `Shift+n`
* Previous annotated page: `Shift+p`
* Scroll page down: `n`, `s`
* Scroll page up: `p`, `w`

<a id="visual-mode"></a>

## Visual mode (`v`, sticky `Shift+v`)

* Select multilayer rectangle: `Shift+r`, `Shift+v`
* Select multilayer region: `Shift+e`
* Select object: `a`, `o`
* Select rectangle: `r`, `v`
* Select region: `e`
* Vertical space: `s`

<a id="resize-mode"></a>

## Resize mode (`r`, sticky `Shift+r`)

* Fine: `s`
* Medium: `d`, `m`, `r`
* Thick: `Shift+d`, `f`, `Shift+m`, `Shift+r`
* Very fine: `a`
* Very thick: `g`
